items.title: Recently Visited
items.subtitle: The Search tab now lists the subreddits you've opened. Reorder its sections under Subreddits > Search Tab.

items.title: Downvote Tap
items.subtitle: Tap a score again to downvote. Turn it on under Posts & Feeds > Info Row.

items.title: Better Images
items.subtitle: Inline images open fullscreen right away, uploads to Reddit post correctly, and subreddit icons stay current.

items.title: Fixes Across the App
items.subtitle: A crash fix for album previews, Poll shortcuts that work, and a Notifications screen that explains itself.
